source_PC24_path: S_DEC waits win_admit/win_idle; descriptor schedules128rows,17sectors each; S_ISSUE waits units/ready/kv_ok/!kvd_v/win_idle before ME issue. Static inspected PC24 path has no identified circular prefetch/ME-go dependency; not a no-deadlock proof.
exact_command: Decoded unit can be read from existing dbg_state; issue_unit names LAST issued unit. Raw instruction/class/address/count require source-pinned programme metadata and real observer. Neither a busy bit nor last issue identifies current active provider operation.
owned_observer_mapping: 1020-bit new wrapper exposes generation/user/row/sector/tag/address/accept/reply/publish; counts after accepted, qualified packet events. Not present in original compiled live classes; cannot retroactively observe live process.
